license_note: Grok Imagine Image 2.0 is served, not distributed, under the xAI enterprise terms and acceptable use policy that already govern the reviewed Grok records. The policy forbids using the service or its output to develop competing machine learning models and forbids distilling model data or outputs. No weights are released.

license_evidence.scope: Business access to Grok Imagine image generation through the SpaceXAI API and related services
Acceptable-use, anti-distillation, and competing-model restrictions incorporated into xAI service access

access_boundary: This record represents Grok Imagine Image 2.0 under the API model name grok-imagine-image-2.0. The retiring grok-imagine-image-quality slug, which xAI will redirect to this model, the original grok-imagine-image 1.0, the Grok Imagine video models, and the Grok consumer apps are separate boundaries.
strengths: A dedicated model page names the slug, supported regions, batch availability, and per-resolution and per-quality pricing
Release notes document behavior changes to the quality parameter and the successor role for the retiring Image Quality slug
tradeoffs: Closed weights served only through the xAI API under terms that bar competing-model development and distillation
No dated snapshot identifier is documented, and the default quality moved from medium to auto in a release note

evidence.label: xAI model overview naming Grok Imagine Image 2.0 as the image model
xAI release notes documenting the quality parameter change and the Image Quality retirement
